title: The liquidity-lock gate passes on any active lock, however small a share of the LP tokens it covers

evidence.note: any holder with is_locked and a future end time passes; holder.percent is never read
locks.some(unlock_date > now): any unexpired lock passes
locks.some(unlockDate > now): any unexpired lock passes

evidence.ref: sed -n of the three provider files at the base SHA (22-27 merge)
evidence.note: Claude verification: none of the three providers compares the locked share with the total LP supply.

sibling_sites_checked: All three providers in isLiquidityLockedForChain (tokenSafety.ts:320-326), used on all four chains; the legacy isLiquidityLocked (tokenSafety.ts:76) accepts any active lock too. V3 has no lock check (bot.ts:1291).
severity_rationale: S1: locking a sliver of LP and keeping the rest withdrawable is a known rug pattern. The gate exists to reject that case and passes it, on every V2 snipe. Graded LOSS. The anti-rug watcher is separate protection and defaults to dry-run.
recommendation: Require a minimum locked share of total LP supply (a number to decide in card BUY-05, with its AC-37 threshold row at that point). Phase 24 (capital). Nothing is fixed in Phase 22 (NAC-13).
